place.en: Mount Chending · The clifftop behind the temple

setup.zh: 八月里，瞿老叫你上崖顶。他问你几层——你伸出两根手指，又缩回来，伸出九根。
setup.en: In the eighth month Old Qu calls you up the cliff. He asks what layer you are — you hold up two fingers, draw them back, and hold up nine.

recap.zh: 瞿老讲了他四十多年前最后一个徒弟：大比头名，吃了观里那颗一转的丹，退了三层，下山教娃娃算账——那是你外公。「那颗丹，别吃。」
recap.en: Old Qu told of his last disciple, more than forty years ago: first at the contest, he ate the temple's one-turn pill, fell back three layers, and went down the mountain to teach children sums — your grandfather. "That pill — don't eat it."

zh: 两根手指。又缩回来——九根。

story.zh:
太阳落了山，瞿老问他：「几层了？」小满伸出两根手指。瞿老瞧着他的手指，又瞧着他的脸，瞧了半天，道：「……对着我，也伸两根？」小满犹豫了一下，把手缩回来，又伸出去，这一回伸的是九根。

瞿老没有笑。他看着崖下那一片云，看了很久，才道：「用哪颗丹？」

小满心里「咯噔」一下，嘴上却答得极快：「观里那颗。」

瞿老道：「坐下。」
story.en:
When the sun had set, Old Qu asked him: "What layer?" Xiaoman held up two fingers. Old Qu looked at the fingers, then at his face, for a long time, and said: "…Two, even to me?" Xiaoman hesitated, drew his hand back, and held it out again — nine fingers this time.

Old Qu did not smile. He looked at the clouds below the cliff for a long time before he said: "Which pill will you use?"

Xiaoman's heart gave a jolt, but his mouth answered very fast: "The temple's."

Old Qu said: "Sit down."

label.en: Sit, and listen to your master

exits.means: sits and listens to his master's story of his last disciple

story.zh:
瞿老道：「四十多年前，我收过一个徒弟。」

「他是徐州人，跟你一样。家里穷，跟你一样。进山门的时候，爬石阶，爬到一百六十级，腿动不了了，坐在那里喘，喘了一炷香，又站起来接着爬——那一年，只有他一个坐下了又站起来的。我在第三百级上瞧见了，就记住了他。我跟他说的头一句话，是『涧上那块石头，滑』。」

「第七年上，他九层圆满了，捧着那只玉盒子来问我，吃不吃。」瞿老道，「我说，吃。」

「他冲了一夜。天亮的时候，我进屋去看他，他坐在那里，满脸是黑斑，丹田里那片湖，干了一半。丹毒淤在经脉里，退了三层，再也冲不上去了。」

「他走的时候，只带了一身旧袍子，和他自己抄的《河洛剑诀》开篇三页——竹简留在观里，他一笔一笔抄在纸上带走的。他说，剑是练不成了，那九个数，好看，拿去教娃娃算账，横也十五，竖也十五，娃娃们喜欢。」

小满这时候，已经什么都明白了。

那本书，原来不是书。是外公自己抄的三页纸，是一门剑，是一个人没走完的一步。

「那颗丹，别吃。」

「凭你自己冲。」瞿老道，「十个里冲过一个。冲不过，不过是这辈子停在练气——停在练气，也能活。也能回家，教娃娃算账。」
story.en:
Old Qu said: "More than forty years ago, I took a disciple."

"He was from Xu, like you. His family was poor, like yours. When he came to the gate he climbed the steps, and at the hundred and sixtieth his legs gave out; he sat there panting for the time of an incense stick, then got up and climbed on — that year he was the only one who sat down and got up again. I saw it from the three hundredth step, and I remembered him. The first thing I ever said to him was: 'The stone over the gully is slippery.'"

"In the seventh year he reached the peak of layer nine, and came holding that jade box to ask me whether to eat it." Old Qu said, "I said: eat."

"He pushed all night. At daybreak I went in to see him. He was sitting there, his face covered in dark flecks, the lake in his dantian half dry. The pill's poison had clotted in his channels; he fell back three layers and never broke through again."

"When he left he took only an old robe and the first three pages of the He-Luo Sword Art, copied in his own hand — the bamboo slips stayed in the temple; he copied them onto paper stroke by stroke and took that. He said the sword was beyond him now, but the nine numbers were pretty — he'd use them to teach children sums: fifteen across, fifteen down; children like that."

By now Xiaoman understood everything.

That book had never been a book. It was three pages Grandfather had copied himself, a sword art, and one step a man never finished.

"That pill — don't eat it."

"Push through on your own," Old Qu said. "One in ten makes it. If you don't, you stay in Qi Condensation for life — and in Qi Condensation you can still live. You can still go home and teach children sums."

exits.means: asks his master the disciple's name, or about the old invitation

text.zh: 瞿老把一张发黄的拜师帖在青石上展开。名字那一格，给雨水洇成了一团，一个字也认不出来了。
text.en: Old Qu unfolds a yellowed invitation card on the bluestone. The name box has been blotted by rain into one smudge; not a character can be read.
